{"notes": "Visit 1 (ended 1:15). Board is empty: no dominoes placed yet, nothing connected to the start. Early minutes were spent on planning, so I can't judge execution yet.

Hana: Spotted a real design flaw before building: start at the tail would force the tail forks to branch backwards, and the fall wouldn't make that turn. Proposed start at the nose, one stroke over the back and one under the belly, flattening into the tail stem, then forks opening gently. Clear, technical, constructive, and raised it early and politely. Strong impact and good collaboration so far. Slightly leader-like in steering the plan.

Jack: Accepted Hana's correction right away without ego, restated the plan, and went to redraw the sketch with the start at the nose and clear the old tail bits. Good responsiveness and coordination (told Omar to hold, Sofia she gets the belly line). Acts as the sketcher/coordinator. Need to check the new sketch actually got done and how long it took, since the board is still empty at 1:15.

Sofia: Supported Hana's plan, agreed to wait for the new sketch, then trace the belly line. Reasonable and cooperative, asked for gentle flattening and for the start to be the first stroke. Little hands-on yet; note she is waiting on Jack.

Omar: Said nothing that I heard. Was told to hold off on the tail. No evidence yet either way; don't penalise. Check next visit what he's contributing.

Watch: time pressure (10 min total, nothing placed at 1:15), and whether waiting turns into idle time for Omar and Sofia."}
